i.norm: Verifies that replaceIn(StringBuffer) reports "no substitution made" (returns false) when the prefix/suffix matchers never recognise a complete variable in the buffer, and that the configured escape character is preserved on the substitutor.
A variable resolver that is never actually consulted (no variable is matched).
A matcher used as both the prefix and suffix matcher. Its isMatch(...) stub returns 0 (no match) for most probes, so a full variable is never delimited.
